current_canonical.selection: explicit reviewed claim IDs; never latest glob

reproducibility_assets.note: includes historical intermediate inputs required by current evaluators; superseded as a claim does not mean disposable

raw_data.policy: preserve originals, authors released tables, local lab inventory and immutable evaluation supports; mixed raw/features directories must not be deleted as a unit

rebuildable_cache.policy: derived normalization/concatenation with source manifests, but current E2R experts consume these; retain online. Rebuildable does not mean currently removable

historical_superseded.policy: in-place archival for results; no destructive tree-wide migration

rejected_experiments.policy: canonical negative evidence, not active experts and not garbage

operational_state.policy: live service state, sessions and caches; outside model-evaluation claims; preserve

unknown.policy: classification unresolved at this audit; preserve. Neither historical nor deletable can be inferred solely from a name or mtime.
